records.source: Er... hi. I'm Clint.#$e#I'm the town blacksmith. If you ever need to upgrade your tools, I'm your guy.
records.translation: Ah... kumusta. Ako si Clint.#$e#Ako ang panday ng bayan. Kung kailangan mong pahusayin ang mga kasangkapan mo, lapitan mo ako.

records.source: I don't usually get birthday gifts. This actually means a lot, @. Thank you.
records.translation: Hindi ako karaniwang nakatatanggap ng regalo sa kaarawan. Talagang napakahalaga nito sa akin, @. Salamat.

records.source: Is this a birthday gift? It's, uh... an interesting choice. Well I appreciate that you remembered me, anyway.
records.translation: Regalo ba ito sa kaarawan? Isa itong, ah... kawili-wiling pagpili. Aba, nagpapasalamat pa rin akong naalala mo ako.

records.source: You're giving this... to me? I don't think I deserve it, but.. thank you.
records.translation: Ibinibigay mo ito... sa akin? Sa tingin ko, hindi ako karapat-dapat dito, pero... salamat.

records.source: Oh, interesting... These books aren't very easy to come by in the valley.#$b#Looks like there's a lot of good tips in here. Thanks, @.
records.translation: Ah, kawili-wili... Hindi madaling makuha ang mga aklat na ito sa lambak.#$b#Mukhang maraming magagandang payo rito. Salamat, @.

records.source: Ah, I can tell from the scratch marks on your pickaxe that you've reached a deeper layer of the mines.#$e#If it starts getting difficult to break stones, you'll want to upgrade your pickaxe. I can help.
records.translation: Ah, masasabi ko sa mga gasgas sa Piko mo na narating mo na ang mas malalim na antas ng mga Minahan.#$e#Kung nagsisimula nang mahirap basagin ang mga bato, kailangan mong pahusayin ang Piko mo. Matutulungan kita.

records.source: It's situations like this where a person's true character is put to the test.#$e#I'll keep Em... I mean, I'll keep everyone safe from the toxic rain!
records.translation: Sa ganitong sitwasyon nasusubok ang tunay na pagkatao.#$e#Pananatilihin kong ligtas si Em... ang ibig kong sabihin, pananatilihin kong ligtas ang lahat sa nakalalasong ulan!

records.source: Well that was a dud. And here I thought it was finally my chance to be a hero. Oh well... Back to the grindstone.
records.translation: Aba, walang nangyari. Akala ko pa naman pagkakataon ko na sa wakas upang maging bayani. Ayos lang... Balik sa hasaan.

records.source: I feel bad admitting it, but sometimes I wish there was a real disaster, not just some dumb green rain.#$b#Something to shake everything up, you know?#$b#Not that I want people to get hurt...#$b#I just want to feel alive... To feel like I have a purpose...
records.translation: Masama man aminin, minsan ay hinihiling kong magkaroon ng totoong sakuna at hindi lamang hangal na berdeng ulan.#$b#Isang bagay na yayanig sa lahat, alam mo?#$b#Hindi naman sa gusto kong may masaktan...#$b#Gusto ko lang maramdamang buhay ako... Maramdamang may layunin ako...

records.source: Interesting. There's tiny iridium flakes on your pickaxe... you've been going to the desert caves, huh?#$e#I've always wanted to smelt with iridium. It's not easy to come by.
records.translation: Kawili-wili. May maliliit na piraso ng iridyum sa Piko mo... nagpupunta ka sa mga yungib sa disyerto, ano?#$e#Noon ko pa gustong magtunaw gamit ang iridyum. Hindi madaling makahanap nito.

records.source: Did Emily say anything about our date the other day?#$b#Wait, don't tell me... I'm better off not knowing. Maybe I can still salvage my dignity.$s
records.translation: May sinabi ba si Emily tungkol sa paglabas namin noong isang araw?#$b#Sandali, huwag mong sabihin... Mas mabuting hindi ko malaman. Baka maisalba ko pa ang dignidad ko.$s

records.source: I... um... heard that you and Emily are together. Congratulations.$s
records.translation: Ako... ah... narinig kong kayo na ni Emily. Binabati kita.$s

records.source: %Clint is looking at the ground and won't say anything to you.
records.translation: %Nakatitig si Clint sa lupa at ayaw kang kausapin.

records.source: I've been feeling strangely hopeful lately.
records.translation: Kakaiba ang pag-asang nararamdaman ko nitong mga nakaraan.

records.source: I'm gonna put on my special red trunks. They're supposed to be really eye-catching.
records.translation: Isusuot ko ang natatangi kong pulang salawal panlangoy. Talagang kapansin-pansin daw iyon.

records.source: Well, that didn't turn out like I was imagining...
records.translation: Aba, hindi iyon nangyari gaya ng inakala ko...

records.source: Oh no... I forgot to clip my toenails.$s
records.translation: Naku... Nakalimutan kong gupitin ang mga kuko ko sa paa.$s

records.source: I thought working a furnace would have prepared me for this heat, but I'm sweating in places I didn't know I could.$s#$e#I hope no one noticed...#$e#%Clint's body is glistening...
records.translation: Akala ko, naihanda na ako ng pagtatrabaho sa pugon para sa init na ito, pero pinagpapawisan ako sa mga bahaging hindi ko alam na maaari pala.$s#$e#Sana walang nakapansin...#$e#%Kumikinang ang katawan ni Clint...

records.source: Ow... my whole torso is burnt to a crisp.$s
records.translation: Aray... Sunog na sunog ang buong katawan ko.$s

records.source: I'm hungry...$s
records.translation: Gutom na ako...$s

records.source: *sigh*... We're all at the beach but I still feel so alone...$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Nasa dalampasigan tayong lahat, pero pakiramdam ko ay nag-iisa pa rin ako...$s

records.source: Hmm... That's an interesting stone, like nothing I've ever seen before.#$b#I wouldn't know what to do with it, though. I deal in the mundane, not the magical...
records.translation: Hmm... Kawili-wiling bato iyan, hindi tulad ng anumang nakita ko.#$b#Pero hindi ko alam ang gagawin diyan. Mga karaniwang bagay ang pinakikitunguhan ko, hindi mga mahiwaga...

records.source: Somehow, the old town minecart system started working again. It's very convenient for getting to and from the mines.#$b#Don't get too cozy, though... if it can start up so suddenly, it could just as well shut down...
records.translation: Sa kung anong paraan, gumana ulit ang lumang sistema ng kariton ng minahan sa bayan. Napakadali nitong gamitin papunta at mula sa mga Minahan.#$b#Pero huwag kang masyadong kampante... Kung bigla itong gumana, maaari rin itong biglang tumigil...

records.source: Yep. I'm a blacksmith.#$e#My father was also a blacksmith.#$e#My grandfather was a blacksmith as well.$u#$q 9/9 Mon_old#I bet you can't guess what my great-grandfather was...#$r 9 30 Mon_9#A blacksmith.#$r 9 50 Mon_clown#A silly clown.#$r 9 -50 Mon_rude#A sarcastic jerk.
records.translation: Oo. Panday ako.#$e#Panday din ang tatay ko.#$e#Panday din ang lolo ko.$u#$q 9/9 Mon_old#Tiyak kong hindi mo mahuhulaan kung ano ang trabaho ng lolo sa tuhod ko...#$r 9 30 Mon_9#Isang panday.#$r 9 50 Mon_clown#Isang hangal na payaso.#$r 9 -50 Mon_rude#Isang mapanuyang tarantado.

records.source: And yes, my great-grandfather was also a blacksmith.
records.translation: At oo, panday din ang lolo sa tuhod ko.

records.source: How'd you know?$u
records.translation: Paano mo nalaman?$u

records.source: Hahahaha. Good one.$h
records.translation: Hahahaha. Maganda iyon.$h

records.source: Wow. That was rude. I was just being funny and you took it to a whole new level.
records.translation: Wow. Ang bastos noon. Nagbibiro lang ako at dinala mo iyon sa ibang antas.

records.source: Be glad you're a farmer, @. It's nicer to work outdoors than by a hot furnace all day.#$e#I'm only a blacksmith because my father pushed me into it.
records.translation: Pasalamat kang magsasaka ka, @. Mas masarap magtrabaho sa labas kaysa sa tabi ng mainit na pugon buong araw.#$e#Panday lang ako dahil pinilit ako ng tatay ko sa propesyong ito.

records.source: If you want me to upgrade your tools you'll have to give me the correct ore.#$e#And you'll have to pay me a fee, of course.
records.translation: Kung gusto mong pahusayin ko ang mga kasangkapan mo, kailangan mong ibigay sa akin ang tamang mineral.#$e#At siyempre, kailangan mo akong bayaran.

records.source: Hey. What do you need?
records.translation: Uy. Ano ang kailangan mo?

records.source: Oh, hi @. Sorry If I look a little messy. I've been working at the furnace all morning.$h#$e#So, did you need anything, or do you just want to visit?
records.translation: Ah, kumusta, @. Paumanhin kung medyo magulo ang hitsura ko. Buong umaga akong nagtatrabaho sa pugon.$h#$e#Kaya, may kailangan ka ba o dumalaw ka lang?

records.source: Business has been slow lately.#$e#You should upgrade your tools. I could use the cash.
records.translation: Mahina ang negosyo nitong mga nakaraan.#$e#Dapat mong pahusayin ang mga kasangkapan mo. Kailangan ko ang pera.

records.source: I heard Emily has a friend who lives in the desert. Do you know anything about her?#$e#I wonder if she's single...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong may kaibigang nakatira sa disyerto si Emily. May alam ka ba tungkol sa kaniya?#$e#May kasintahan kaya siya...$s

records.source: The weather doesn't really matter to me. I typically stay near my shop year-round.#$e#Depressing, huh?
records.translation: Hindi gaanong mahalaga sa akin ang panahon. Karaniwan akong nananatili malapit sa pandayan buong taon.#$e#Nakalulungkot, ano?

records.source: I should save up and buy a computer...#$e#Maybe I can find a girlfriend on the 'internet'...$s#$e#What? Don't judge me! Not everyone is a cool, attractive, socially-adept farmer, you know!$u#$e#What's a guy like me supposed to do? *Groan*$s
records.translation: Dapat akong mag-ipon at bumili ng kompyuter...#$e#Baka makahanap ako ng kasintahan sa “internet”...$s#$e#Ano? Huwag mo akong husgahan! Hindi lahat ay astig, kaakit-akit, at mahusay makisalamuhang magsasaka, alam mo!$u#$e#Ano ang dapat gawin ng isang tulad ko? *daing*$s

records.source: Sometimes I wonder how I ended up in this town.$u
records.translation: Minsan ay iniisip ko kung paano ako napadpad sa bayang ito.$u

records.source: Damn it, I'm too old to do anything exciting anymore. All I have to look forward to is years and years of sweaty, hot furnace-work.
records.translation: Lintik, masyado na akong matanda upang gumawa ng anumang kapana-panabik. Ang tanging aasahan ko ay napakaraming taon ng mainit at pawisang trabaho sa pugon.

records.source: How are your tools holding up?#$b#If they ever need repairs, just come by my shop. I guarantee these tools for life!
records.translation: Kumusta ang kalagayan ng mga kasangkapan mo?#$b#Kung kailangan ng pagkukumpuni ang mga iyon, dumaan ka lang sa pandayan. Habambuhay ang garantiya ko sa mga kasangkapang ito!

records.source: Don't you have work to do?
records.translation: Wala ka bang trabahong dapat gawin?

records.source: So how are your tools holding up?
records.translation: Kaya, kumusta ang kalagayan ng mga kasangkapan mo?

records.source: I don't know if people realize this, or care, but I do take a lot of pride in my work.#$e#I mean... When I was a boy I didn't really dream of becoming a blacksmith. But that's what I am. And I want to be the best blacksmith I can be.
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung napapansin o pinahahalagahan ito ng mga tao, pero lubos kong ipinagmamalaki ang trabaho ko.#$e#Ang ibig kong sabihin... Noong bata ako, hindi ko naman pinangarap maging panday. Pero ito ako ngayon. At gusto kong maging pinakamahusay na panday na kaya ko.

records.source: Okay... I'll keep that in mind.
records.translation: Sige... Tatandaan ko iyon.

records.source: That's the problem... I do act natural... but I never have any success.$s
records.translation: Iyon ang problema... Likas naman ang kilos ko... pero hindi ako kailanman nagtatagumpay.$s

records.source: I hate to say it, but sometimes I'm glad my father forced me to become a blacksmith. At least I have a profession.#$e#If I didn't have work to do, I'd probably spend all day just sitting around feeling sorry for myself.$s
records.translation: Ayaw ko mang sabihin, minsan ay natutuwa akong pinilit ako ng tatay kong maging panday. May propesyon man lang ako.#$e#Kung wala akong trabahong gagawin, malamang buong araw lang akong uupo at maaawa sa sarili.$s
